name: Suggestion Chips
hint: Pick a follow-up: the chip lifts, flies into the thread and becomes your message. Try Fill mode, Refresh and Delete.
description: Prompt suggestions for an AI assistant, in two places: starter cards on the empty first screen, grouped under icon-and-label headings, and compact follow-ups after an answer. Choosing one is visible: the chip lifts, travels to the thread (send) or into the composer with its editable parts highlighted and the first one selected (fill), and morphs into the message while the remaining chips close the gap. While follow-ups are generated, skeleton chips of plausible widths hold their place; then the new set arrives, staggered once. Refresh shuffles the set and keeps focus, single chips can be dismissed, long suggestions truncate in the middle, and phones get one snap rail with edge fades.
intents: suggested follow-up questions under an AI chat answer
conversation starters on an empty chat screen

usage: Use it for follow-up suggestions under an assistant's answer, or starter cards on an empty chat. Pass `suggestions` as [{ id, text, icon?, group?, title?, slots? }] (`label` works in place of `text`); `icon` is an icon name or your own node, `group` a short label, `title` the starter card's heading, and [brackets] in `text` (or `slots`) mark the parts a user is expected to edit in fill mode. `status` is yours: "loading" holds the space with skeleton chips while the model answers, "ready" shows the set (it arrives staggered), "empty" shows `emptyText`, "error" shows `errorText` with a retry button that calls `onRetry` (or `onRefresh`). `onChoose(item, { mode, text })` fires when one is chosen: in send mode append `text` as the user's message, in fill mode put it in your composer. `onRefresh()` asks for another set (replace `suggestions`), `onDismiss(item)` reports a dismissed chip (it hides at once). Pass `flyTo` (a ref, or a function returning the composer or the thread's last row) and the chosen chip flies there; without it, it lifts and fades. `count` caps how many are shown (4 by default). Keyboard: one tab stop, arrows and Home/End move, Enter or Space chooses, Delete dismisses. With no props it renders nothing. The framed chat stage (thread, composer) and the sample kitchen deck appear only with `demo`, or set `frame` yourself.

dataProps.description: The suggestions, in order. text (or label) is what is sent; icon is an icon name or a ReactNode; group labels a run of chips; title heads a starter card; slots lists the editable parts (or put them in [brackets]).
Owned by the caller. loading shows skeleton chips and blocks choosing; empty shows emptyText; error shows errorText with a retry button.
(item, { mode: "send" | "fill", text }) => void, when a suggestion is chosen by click, Enter or Space.
() => void, when the refresh control is pressed. Replace `suggestions` with a new set. Without it (and with your own suggestions) the refresh control is hidden.
(item) => void, when a chip is dismissed with its x or Delete. It is hidden locally at once; a new `suggestions` array clears that.
() => void, for the retry button in the error state (falls back to onRefresh).
(text) => void, when the built-in composer is submitted. Only with the frame.
